dhp273:1: Of paths, the eightfold is best.
dhp273:4:
Of two-footed beings,
the one with the eyes
to see.
dhp274:1:
Just this
is the path
–there is no other–
dhp274:4:
and that will be Mara’s
bewilderment.
dhp275:2:
you put an end
to suffering & stress.
dhp275:3: I have taught you this path
dhp275:4:
having known
–for your knowing–
the extraction of arrows.
dhp276:1:
It’s for you to strive
ardently.
dhp276:2:
Tathagatas simply
point out the way.
dhp276:3:
Those who practice,
absorbed in jhana:
dhp276:4:
from Mara’s bonds
they’ll be freed.
dhp277:4:
This is the path
to purity.
dhp278:4:
This is the path
to purity.
dhp279:4:
This is the path
to purity.
dhp280:1:
At the time for initiative
he takes no initiative.
dhp280:3:
the resolves of his heart
exhausted,
dhp280:4:
the lazy, lethargic one
loses the path
to discernment.
dhp281:1:
Guarded
in speech,
well-restrained
in mind,
dhp281:2:
you should do nothing unskillful
in body.
dhp281:3:
Purify
these three courses of action.
dhp281:4:
Bring to fruition
the path that seers have proclaimed.
dhp283:1:
Cut down
the forest of desire,
not the forest of trees.
dhp283:2:
From the forest of desire
come danger & fear.
dhp283:3:
Having cut down this forest
& its underbrush,
dhp284:1:
For as long as the least
bit of underbrush
dhp284:2:
of a man for women
is not cleared away,
dhp284:4:
like a suckling calf
on its mother.
dhp285:2:
like an autumn lily
in the hand.
dhp285:3: Nurture only the path to peace
dhp285:4:
–Unbinding–
as taught by the One Well Gone.
dhp287:2: all tangled up in the mind:
dhp287:4:
as a great flood,
a village asleep.
dhp288:1:
There are
no sons
to give shelter,
dhp288:3: for one seized by the Ender,
dhp289:2: the wise man, restrained by virtue,
dhp289:3:
should make the path pure
–right away–
dhp289:4: that goes all the way to Unbinding.
